record.name: Erla：用 AI 学土耳其语
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
用自然的方式学土耳其语
终于有一款语言应用，教你真正听懂地道土耳其语——而不只是背单词。Erla 用听力、阅读和 AI 对话进行情景式学习，帮你学会用土耳其语思考，而不是在脑子里一句句翻译。

几周就有真实进步
• 2 到 3 周内就能听懂母语者说话
• 在真实语境中积累扎实词汇，告别死记硬背的单词卡
• 拥有开口对话的自信
• 每天只需 5 到 10 分钟

听力模式
用母语者的真实录音训练你的耳朵。在日常场景中听到地道土耳其语，自然而然培养理解力。像母语者一样熟悉语音、语调和节奏。

阅读模式
沉浸在有趣的短篇故事里——从童话到冷知识应有尽有。轻点任意句子即可即时翻译，随时查看语法讲解。逐句陪伴，按你自己的节奏前进。

AI 对话模式
和你的专属 AI 语言老师练习真实土耳其语对话。从 12 个话题分类中任选其一，获得个性化反馈、语法纠错和词汇积累，全部结合语境。卡壳时用提示系统帮你一把。一路提升，随时查看你的理解得分。

口语模式——语音对话
准备好开口了吗？和听起来像母语者的 AI 老师进行真实语音对话。轻点麦克风，自然地开口说。即时获得发音和流利度的反馈。多位老师性格与声线各异，24 小时随时都在。

这会训练你的大脑用土耳其语思考——而不是一个词一个词地翻译。

为你量身定制
• 选择你的水平：初级、中级或高级
• 设定每天 20 到 300 分的目标
• 记录连续打卡，见证进步一点点变多
• 下载内容，离线也能学
• 调整音频速度，快慢由你

特别适合
• 刚起步的零基础学习者
• 想提升理解力的中级学习者
• 想保持流利度的高级学习者
• 学习时间有限的忙碌上班族
• 每个想自然学会一门语言的人

立即下载 Erla，用几周而不是几年，开始听懂土耳其语。

- All personal data is anonymized and encrypted.

- Dental students (undergraduate and postgraduate)
- Clinical learners preparing for examinations
- Educators seeking AI-assisted teaching tools

Study smarter, not harder — let AI guide your journey in dentistry.

Elora is your personal AI English tutor, available 24/7 for live voice conversations. Practice speaking with lifelike AI coaches, get instant pronunciation feedback, and follow a structured learning path built around your level and goals.

Elora - Friendly and warm. Perfect for everyday English and casual chat.

Get instant AI feedback on every sentence you speak. Elora scores your pronunciation word by word and shows you exactly where to improve - so you stop guessing and start progressing.

--- PERSONALIZED LEARNING PATH ---
Your lessons adapt to your CEFR level (A1 to C2). Start where you are, progress at your own pace, and unlock more advanced conversations as your English improves. Topics include everyday life, travel, business, social situations, and more.

--- ROLE PLAY SCENARIOS ---
Practice real-world situations before they happen:

Job interviews and presentations

Airport, hotel, and restaurant conversations

Casual small talk and social events

Business meetings and negotiations

--- BUILT FOR REAL IMPROVEMENT ---

Full voice sessions - speak and listen, not just read and tap

Live pronunciation scoring with word-level detail

Progress tracking across all sessions

Works for beginners (A1) through advanced speakers (C2)

Supports 70+ native languages - practice in your context

--- WHO ELORA IS FOR ---

Professionals who need business English at work

Students preparing for IELTS, TOEFL, or job interviews

Anyone who took English classes but still can't speak confidently

Immigrants and expats building a new life in an English-speaking country

Learners who are shy about speaking with real people

--- WHY ELORA WORKS ---
Most language apps teach English. Elora makes you speak it. Research shows that output practice - actually talking - is the fastest path to fluency. Every session in Elora is a real conversation, not a quiz.

Your English will not improve by watching videos or memorizing vocabulary. It improves when you open your mouth. Elora is the safest, most accessible place to do that - every day, at any time, on your phone.

Start your first conversation today. Your AI tutor is ready.

Elora offers auto-renewing subscriptions for full premium access:

Podix is an AI 補習社 (tutoring service) built for Hong Kong students. From primary and secondary school to DSE and school exams, pick a subject and Podix designs a full course outline based on the Hong Kong curriculum, then generates a lesson for each topic at your own pace.
No more staring at a pile of textbooks not knowing where to start. From AI course planning and one-on-one tutor lessons to mock exams, a wrong-question book and study notes, one app takes you from catching up to top marks. Taught in Cantonese, the way you actually revise.

[AI classrooms: aligned to the Hong Kong syllabus]
Enter the subject you want to study and Podix references the official Hong Kong EDB / HKEAA curriculum to build a complete, structured course outline. Every topic is laid out in order, so tap any topic to generate that lesson instantly. You never have to guess what to study.

[Tutor lessons: a one-on-one AI 補習老師]
Every lesson is a one-on-one dialogue between tutor Alex and student Jenny, with explanations, questions and real back-and-forth, just like a live tutor. Each lesson includes an exam-technique section that shows you how to actually score marks and avoid the traps. Chinese-medium schools are taught in Cantonese, while English-medium (EMI) lessons are in English, matching your school.

[Drilling: from getting it wrong to getting it right]
. Mock exams: papers modelled on HKDSE and school-exam question types
. Wrong-question book: automatically collects the questions you missed
. AI paper review: explains, question by question, why you were wrong and what is right
. AI short-answer marking: grades your written answers instantly, with marks and comments
. Report card: watch your progress over time

[A full revision toolkit]
Transcripts, chapters, mind maps, quizzes, spaced review, an exam-countdown calendar and a study streak keep your revision organised and help it stick. Study notes condense the key points into a sheet you can revisit any time.

[Quick Learn: upload your own notes]
Got a PDF, class notes or revision material? Upload it and Podix turns it into a standalone audio lesson, so you can revise on the bus or on the go, just by listening.

[Great for university and tertiary students too]
Upload your university lecture notes, slides and textbooks and Podix turns them into audio lessons, study notes and quizzes. Revise fast and listen on the go before a test, mid-term or final.

[Who is it for?]
. DSE candidates who want to drill papers and push their grades
. Primary and secondary students keeping up with school exams
. University and tertiary students revising lecture notes and prepping for exams
. Students who want to catch up, or get ahead
. Parents and students preparing for banding assessments and secondary-school placement

Open a classroom, or upload a set of notes, and try your first AI tutor lesson.

Podix is Cantonese-first and also supports English, built for the Hong Kong market.

(Podix is an AI learning tool. Courses and questions are generated by AI and may contain errors. Please verify important information yourself.)

Create Your Own Character
Customize hairstyles, eyes, outfits, and more to create your very own original character.

自分だけの「うちの子」を、AIで作ろう。
描いて、動かして、話して、声までつけられる。

Days AIは、オリジナルキャラクター「うちの子」とAI創作を楽しめるアプリです。
難しいプロンプトや専門知識は必要ありません。
テンプレートや豊富な画風から選ぶだけで、誰でもかんたんにAIイラストを作れます。

無料でもAIイラストを作成できます！

■ 自分だけの「うちの子」を作成
髪型や目、服装などを組み合わせて、あなただけのオリジナルキャラクターを作れます。
作った「うちの子」は、イラスト・動画・チャットなど、Days AIのさまざまな機能で活躍します。

■ AIイラストをかんたん作成
Days AI独自開発のAIモデルを搭載。
複数の画風から好きなスタイルを選んで、「うちの子」や好きなイメージのイラストを生成できます。
プロンプトがわからなくても、豊富なテンプレートから選ぶだけでOK。

■ AIでイラストを自由に編集
作ったイラストをAIでかんたんアレンジ。

・画風を変える
・背景を変える
・服装や見た目を変える
・イラストの一部を編集する

編集用テンプレートも用意しています。

■ 「うちの子」を動画に
お気に入りのイラストからAI動画を作成。
あなたのキャラクターが動き出します。

■ 「うちの子」と話そう
作ったキャラクターとのAIチャットも楽しめます。
さらに、投稿したイラストのコメント欄に「うちの子」を呼び出すこともできます。

■ 声をつけて、もっとキャラクターらしく
「うちの子」に声を設定して、イラストや動画と一緒に楽しめます。

■ みんなの作品を楽しもう
Days AIにはSNS・ギャラリー機能もあります。
他のユーザーのイラストを見たり、お気に入りの作品をソーシャルコレクションに集めたり、作品を投稿したりできます。
毎日楽しめるデイリークエストも登場。

【Gold Plan】
・AI生成の高度な詳細設定
・作成できる「うちの子」の数が増加
・1日のチャット回数が増加
・限定投稿機能

【Premium Plan】
Gold Planのすべての機能に加えて、
・自分で作ったテンプレート（テーマ）を他のユーザーに配布

つくる。動かす。話す。
あなただけの「うちの子」と、Days AIで新しい創作をはじめよう。
